description_en: Rolls back or re-executes a worker task in a certificate deployment task

name: UpdateWorkerResourceStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deployment task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712234.html operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task from the JobId parameter. parameters.help_zh: 部署任务ID。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712234.html返回的任务**ID**。也可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712223.html接口获取

parameters.help_en: The ID of the worker task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712224.html operation to obtain the ID of a worker task
